name: plate-43-engine-v17
version_tag: #141 ENGINE SET v17 rev B — plate-43 rev A WOULD NOT ASSEMBLE; do not print it. Its receivers carried a 3mm anti-tilt hub boss (bearing 3->6mm) and stood 6mm tall, but the band gap only allows 3mm of satellite: seated, month and feb drove 2.8mm straight through the carrier arm crossing above them. Neither plate's own gates could see it — the collision was BETWEEN plate-43 and plate-44 — so #141 adds assembly_gate_v17.py, which builds the whole z-stack from the emitted STLs and tests every pair sharing an altitude. FIXES: (1) boss removed from month and feb (they revert to the 3.0mm bearing Ron's bench-winning 131_month_widesquare already runs with, no bind); leap keeps a 1.2mm boss because nothing stacks above it. (2) tower piece 4.5 -> 5.0mm (band 1.5 + slim 3.5): the piece height IS the band spacing, and 5.0 is what buys the carrier arm its 1.3mm plate + 0.5mm pivot pad + 0.2mm running clearance. Taken in the piece, NOT as 0.5mm shims — a 0.5mm shim prints at 2.5 layers and that z error would walk the mesh lamina off its ball band. (3) finger bars now start at r2.0 not r4.0: at r4.0 they were TANGENT to the r4.0 hub, i.e. separate islands in plane, hanging on only via the lamina below — the same weakness behind the #110/#117 finger failures. (4) all parts re-authored as plane-polygon slabs and boolean-unioned, so every one is now a single watertight solid (the old primitive soups were not, and could not be checked). Mesh UNCHANGED and re-proved on the emitted files: roll graze 0.134mm^2 (the accepted uncarved residual, #138), seated play at strike 0.026mm of the 1.12mm window, and the clocking 18.07/6.46/24.85 now cross-checks against an independent derivation to 0.02mm at pitch. 4 parts (print the tower piece x3 = 6 total), flat, no supports, xy-comp -0.06. | QUIET.
